# hllrcon — licence for material derived from it

**hllrcon** — <https://github.com/timraay/hllrcon> — Copyright (c) 2025 Tim Raaymakers.
Licensed **MIT**; the full text is in `LICENSE` beside this file, copied verbatim from the
project at tag `2.0.0.6`. MIT's one condition is that this notice travels with any copy or
substantial portion, which is what this folder is for.

No hllrcon source is vendored here. What this repository takes from it is game data, extracted
from its `hllrcon/data/` modules:

| File in this repository | What comes from hllrcon |
|---|---|
| `packages/maps/src/crcon-layer-data.ts` | Vietnam's maps and layers (`HLLVMap`, `HLLVLayer`, 2.0.0.6), generated by `packages/maps/scripts/extract-crcon-catalogue.py` |
| `packages/games/src/hllv/weapon-names.ts` | Vietnam's weapon names (`hllrcon/data/weapons.py`, 2.0.0.3) |
| `packages/games/src/hllv/data.ts` | Vietnam's factions, teams, roles and weapon classes, from the reference export published with hllrcon 2.0 |
| `packages/games/src/hll.ts` | WW2 role ids, checked against `hllrcon/data/roles.py` (three roles taken from it) |
| `apps/workers/src/crcon-players.ts` | the role ids and faction sides CRCON reads through hllrcon |

Each of those files names hllrcon and points here.
